import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    memberId: 'member-10086',

      { id: 'fresh-week', name: '生鲜周' }

    campaign: {
      title: '夏日清凉特卖',
      subtitle: '限时领券，爆款低至五折'
    },
    campaignUrl: 'https://campaign.example.com/summer-sale?memberId=member-10086',
    loading: true,
    errorText: '',
    trackerReady: false
  },
  methods: {
    switchCampaign (campaignId) {
      if (campaignId === this.campaignId) return
      this.campaignId = campaignId
      this.loading = true
      this.errorText = ''
      this.campaignUrl = `https://campaign.example.com/${campaignId}?memberId=${this.memberId}`
    },
    handleCampaignLoad () {
      this.loading = false
      wx.reportAnalytics('campaign_webview_load', {
        campaign_id: this.campaignId
      })
    },
    handleCampaignError () {
      this.loading = false
      this.errorText = '活动会场暂时无法打开'
    },
    handleCampaignMessage (event) {
      const messages = event.detail.data || []
      const message = messages[messages.length - 1] || {}
      if (message.type === 'claim-coupon') {
        this.claimCoupon(message.couponId)
      }
      if (message.type === 'open-product') {
        this.openProduct(message.productId)
      }
    },
    claimCoupon (couponId) {
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/campaign/coupons/claim',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { campaignId: this.campaignId, couponId },
        success: () => {
          wx.showToast({ title: '领取成功', icon: 'success' })
        }
      })
    },
    openProduct (productId) {
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/packageProduct/pages/detail/index?id=${productId}&campaignId=${this.campaignId}`
      })
    },
    reloadCampaign () {
      const campaignUrl = this.campaignUrl
      this.campaignUrl = ''
      this.campaignUrl = campaignUrl
      this.loading = true
      this.errorText = ''
    },
    handleTrackerReady () {
      this.trackerReady = true
    },
    handleTrackerError () {
      this.trackerReady = false
    }
  }
})

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'
import campaignTracker from '@business/campaign-tracker-web'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    campaignId: {
      type: String,
      observer () {
        this.initTracker()
      }
    },
    memberId: String
  },
  data: {
    ready: false
  },
  ready () {
    this.initTracker()
  },
  detached () {
    this.tracker.destroy()
  },
  methods: {
    async initTracker () {
      if (!this.campaignId) return
      this.ready = false
      const tracker = await campaignTracker.create({
        campaignId: this.campaignId,
        memberId: this.memberId
      })
      this.tracker = tracker
      window.addEventListener('message', this.handleWindowMessage)
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibilityChange)
      tracker.start()
      this.ready = true
      this.triggerEvent('ready', { campaignId: this.campaignId })
    },
    handleWindowMessage (event) {
      const message = event.data || {}
      if (message.type === 'campaign-exposure') {
        this.tracker.track('exposure', message.payload)
      }
    },
    handleVisibilityChange () {
      if (document.hidden) {
        this.tracker.pause()
      } else {
        this.tracker.resume()
      }
    }
  }
})

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

const CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN = 'https://campaign.example.com'

createPage({
  data: {
    memberId: 'member-10086',
    campaignId: 'summer-sale',
    campaigns: [
      { id: 'summer-sale', name: '夏日特卖' },
      { id: 'member-day', name: '会员日' },
      { id: 'fresh-week', name: '生鲜周' }
    ],
    campaign: {
      title: '夏日清凉特卖',
      subtitle: '限时领券，爆款低至五折'
    },
    campaignUrl: `${CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN}/summer-sale?memberId=member-10086&view=1`,
    campaignGeneration: 1,
    loading: true,
    errorText: '',
    trackerReady: false
  },
  methods: {
    buildCampaignUrl (campaignId, generation) {
      return `${CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN}/${encodeURIComponent(campaignId)}?memberId=${encodeURIComponent(this.memberId)}&view=${generation}`
    },
    isCurrentWebViewEvent (event) {
      const detail = event && event.detail ? event.detail : {}
      return !detail.src || detail.src === this.campaignUrl
    },
    switchCampaign (campaignId) {
      if (!campaignId || campaignId === this.campaignId) return
      const generation = this.campaignGeneration + 1
      this.campaignGeneration = generation
      this.campaignId = campaignId
      this.loading = true
      this.errorText = ''
      // Remove the old web-view before mounting the new one. The unique view
      // query also lets load/error events be matched to the active instance.
      this.campaignUrl = ''
      const mount = () => {
        if (generation !== this.campaignGeneration) return
        this.campaignUrl = this.buildCampaignUrl(campaignId, generation)
      }
      if (wx.nextTick) wx.nextTick(mount)
      else mount()
    },
    handleCampaignLoad (event) {
      if (!this.isCurrentWebViewEvent(event)) return
      this.loading = false
      wx.reportAnalytics('campaign_webview_load', {
        campaign_id: this.campaignId
      })
    },
    handleCampaignError (event) {
      if (!this.isCurrentWebViewEvent(event)) return
      this.loading = false
      this.errorText = '活动会场暂时无法打开'
    },
    handleCampaignMessage (event) {
      const messages = event && event.detail && Array.isArray(event.detail.data)
        ? event.detail.data
        : []
      const message = messages[messages.length - 1] || {}
      const payload = message.payload || {}
      // A message without an explicit activity id cannot be safely associated
      // after a fast switch, so it is deliberately ignored.
      const messageCampaignId = message.campaignId || payload.campaignId
      if (!messageCampaignId || messageCampaignId !== this.campaignId) return
      const couponId = message.couponId !== undefined ? message.couponId : payload.couponId
      const productId = message.productId !== undefined ? message.productId : payload.productId
      if (message.type === 'claim-coupon' && couponId !== undefined) {
        this.claimCoupon(couponId, messageCampaignId)
      }
      if (message.type === 'open-product' && productId !== undefined) {
        this.openProduct(productId, messageCampaignId)
      }
    },
    claimCoupon (couponId, campaignId) {
      if (campaignId !== this.campaignId) return
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/campaign/coupons/claim',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { campaignId, couponId },
        success: () => {
          if (campaignId === this.campaignId) {
            wx.showToast({ title: '领取成功', icon: 'success' })
          }
        }
      })
    },
    openProduct (productId, campaignId) {
      if (campaignId !== this.campaignId) return
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/packageProduct/pages/detail/index?id=${encodeURIComponent(productId)}&campaignId=${encodeURIComponent(campaignId)}`
      })
    },
    reloadCampaign () {
      const generation = this.campaignGeneration + 1
      this.campaignGeneration = generation
      this.loading = true
      this.errorText = ''
      this.campaignUrl = ''
      const mount = () => {
        if (generation !== this.campaignGeneration) return
        this.campaignUrl = this.buildCampaignUrl(this.campaignId, generation)
      }
      if (wx.nextTick) wx.nextTick(mount)
      else mount()
    },
    handleTrackerReady (event) {
      if (!event || !event.detail || event.detail.campaignId === this.campaignId) {
        this.trackerReady = true
      }
    },
    handleTrackerError () {
      this.trackerReady = false
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'
import campaignTracker from '@business/campaign-tracker-web'

const CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN = 'https://campaign.example.com'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    campaignId: {
      type: String,
      observer () {
        this.initTracker()
      }
    },
    memberId: String
  },
  data: { ready: false },
  ready () {
    this.destroyed = false
    this.initVersion = this.initVersion || 0
    this.tracker = this.tracker || null
    this.listenersBound = this.listenersBound || false
    this.initTracker()
  },
  detached () {
    this.destroyed = true
    this.initVersion += 1
    this.teardownTracker()
  },
  pageLifetimes: {
    hide () { this.pauseTracker() },
    show () { this.resumeTracker() }
  },
  methods: {
    async initTracker () {
      if (this.destroyed || !this.campaignId) return
      const version = (this.initVersion || 0) + 1
      this.initVersion = version
      const campaignId = this.campaignId
      this.teardownTracker()
      this.ready = false
      try {
        const tracker = await campaignTracker.create({ campaignId, memberId: this.memberId })
        if (this.destroyed || version !== this.initVersion || campaignId !== this.campaignId) {
          if (tracker && tracker.destroy) tracker.destroy()
          return
        }
        this.tracker = tracker
        this.bindListeners()
        tracker.start()
        this.ready = true
        this.triggerEvent('ready', { campaignId })
      } catch (error) {
        if (!this.destroyed && version === this.initVersion && campaignId === this.campaignId) {
          this.ready = false
          this.triggerEvent('error', { campaignId, error })
        }
      }
    },
    bindListeners () {
      if (this.listenersBound) return
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.addEventListener('message', this.handleWindowMessage)
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibilityChange)
      this.listenersBound = true
    },
    unbindListeners () {
      if (!this.listenersBound) return
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.removeEventListener('message', this.handleWindowMessage)
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibilityChange)
      this.listenersBound = false
    },
    teardownTracker () {
      this.unbindListeners()
      const tracker = this.tracker
      this.tracker = null
      if (tracker && tracker.destroy) tracker.destroy()
    },
    handleWindowMessage (event) {
      if (this.destroyed || !this.tracker || !event || event.origin !== CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN) return
      const message = event.data || {}
      const payload = message.payload || {}
      const messageCampaignId = message.campaignId || payload.campaignId
      if (message.type !== 'campaign-exposure' || messageCampaignId !== this.campaignId) return
      this.tracker.track('exposure', payload)
    },
    handleVisibilityChange () {
      if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
      if (document.hidden) this.pauseTracker()
      else this.resumeTracker()
    },
    pauseTracker () {
      if (this.tracker && this.tracker.pause) this.tracker.pause()
    },
    resumeTracker () {
      if (!this.destroyed && this.tracker && this.tracker.resume) this.tracker.resume()
    }
  }
})
</script>

</style>

  "styleIsolation": "isolated"
